CustomField.description: What this section shows. Field Set, Repeater and Table show a Form Component's fields as one record, as repeated rows, or as an editable table. Flow shows a Screen Flow, Lightning Web Component shows a custom component, and Display Text shows rich text only. Set on the Component tab of the page section configurator; the isFieldSet, isRepeater, isTable and isFlow checkboxes are derived from it.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Pick what this section displays: a Field Set, Repeater, or Table form component, an embedded Screen Flow, a custom Lightning Web Component, or static Display Text. Your choice controls which source field becomes visible (Form, Flow, or component name) and which Customize tabs appear.
CustomField.label: Component Type
